caption:
Round 7 of the Cyprus League runs from Saturday to Monday. ⚽

Olympiakos Nicosia host Krasava and Anorthosis host Omonia Aradippou on Saturday. On Sunday, leaders AEL Limassol host Aris Limassol in a Limassol derby at 19:00. On Monday, second-placed AEK Larnaca host third-placed Omonia.

Which game are you watching? 🇨🇾

Source: Cyprus Football Association
